def factor_volume_transition_stress_attenuated_30d(df):
    """Smoothed volume-transition carry with bounded overnight downside-stress attenuation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    baseline = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
    active = volume > baseline
    prior_active = active.shift(1).fillna(False)
    transition = (active & ~prior_active).astype(float)
    close_return = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    event_count = transition.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum()
    carried_return = (transition * close_return).rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum()
    raw_carry = carried_return / (1.0 + event_count)
    overnight_return, intraday_return = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    downside_stress = (-overnight_return).clip(lower=0.0).rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    attenuation = 1.0 - downside_stress.clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.5)
    factor = raw_carry * attenuation
    return factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).rename("factor_volume_transition_stress_attenuated_30d")
rationale: Preserves the qualified parent's 30-bar volume-transition carry, event-count normalization, and low-churn structure while targeting its weaker IC and payoff thickness with one bounded downside-stress modifier. Recent negative overnight returns attenuate the carry modestly, reducing exposure when participation transitions occur during short-horizon overnight stress without replacing the continuous OHLCV-derived signal.
